Important: Check compatibility before buying

A 400W panel doesn't necessarily deliver 400W in real-world conditions. Also, its voltage and current must match your power station's solar input specifications.

For reference, independent testing of the Anker SOLIX 400W panel measured 330W in full sun, approximately 83% of its rated output.
